Storm Heroes League is now open to signups for its inaugural season!

SHL is a new, low stress place for people to get their feet wet in a competitive scene without a huge time commitment (matches will be one best of three series per team, per week). We’re looking to find a max of 16 teams of various skill levels to take part in season one, and they don’t all have to be full rosters (5 to play, but we allow each roster to have 2 subs). Partial teams as well as individual players are encouraged to sign up as well as we hope to hold a draft before the start of the season in order to help round out rosters.

Teams will be randomly matched up in a round robin format to play through the season and will have a week (Monday to Sunday) window to play each rounds game. Matchups will be announced ahead of time so captains will have ample time to work out team schedules. At the end of each season, the team rankings will determine seeding and we’ll be able to run a knock out tournament from there.

We don’t have a firm start date nailed down yet, as we’re waiting to get teams signed up, but all of that will be communicated to our players as soon as it’s available. Optimally we would like to have our draft by the end of July, and have our first matches start in early august.

If you’re interested, you can find more information and sign up for free on our website - www.storm-league.org. If you have any questions, please feel free to either leave a comment below, or email them directly to admin@storm-league.org.
